name: recall
description: Private, encrypted memory about you, shared by every AI agent you use.
long_description: Recall gives every AI agent the same memory of you: your preferences, background, projects and how you like to work. It runs entirely on your computer in an encrypted store, with fuzzy search powered by a tiny bundled embedding model. Optionally point it at a Recall server in your Tailscale tailnet to share one memory across all your devices.

tools.name: recall
tools.description: Search what is known about the user, or get their whole profile.

tools.name: remember
tools.description: Save one durable fact about the user.

tools.name: forget
tools.description: Remove a memory that is wrong or outdated.

remote_url.title: Shared server URL (optional)
remote_url.description: To share one memory across devices, the URL of a Recall server in your Tailscale tailnet, e.g. http://pi:7878/mcp. Leave empty to keep memory on this computer.

remote_token.title: Shared server token (optional)
remote_token.description: Token from `recall token add NAME` on the server.
